note: Every monster of assets/registry/bestiary.json needs a line here (key: its name), or the site build fails. Sprites without a bestiary record show only their picture and name.
wolf: A fast forest hunter that comes in packs and goes for the legs.
goblin: A small cave raider. Weak alone, dangerous in a swarm.
goblin chieftain: The boss of a goblin band. Its presence makes the goblins around it hit harder.
goblin warrior: A goblin with a knife and a pocket of stones, the backbone of a band.
goblin shaman: A goblin that throws sparks and keeps its kin on their feet.
